content.summary: A disguised hotel technician secures a repair case, reveals as an engineer and clears the route. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One mission object remains protected through the pursuit. + The disguised identity remains stable before the reveal. + The object is secured before combat escalation. + The reveal preserves the same adult face and body. + The final actions clear the route and return to the secured object.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow an adult hotel technician in a formal service disguise carrying one sealed silver repair case. Place the case safely beside a marked control cabinet before any identity reveal. Use one block, one elbow redirect and one door-close action to clear the route, then hold beside the secured case.
